evidence_interpretation: Conditional center/conservative scenarios use actual steady mixed updates and real validation/adapter serialization/reload/beam20. Additional formal Trainer/DS checkpoint, selection and best restore costs are NOT TESTED. Remaining_to_96_hours is the combined capacity for these costs beyond the stated margin. Only three steady mixed updates and eight distinct measured generation users are available; no statistically calibrated 96h completion guarantee or sustained throughput validation is claimed.
